submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively at a mid-phrase hinge token that extends an already-open phrase with a licensed continuation: a relational noun plus its relator (capital of), a change-of-state verb launching its object (opened the), a VP-capping subordinator (fry until), a list separator (name,), a temporal relator (Friday at), or a fixed-collocation onset (far, second, converts). Strength is set jointly by the head in the preceding 1-3 tokens plus the hinge itself, ramping over the head and falling once the complement arrives; the same surface token with an unlicensing head (giraffe/split head before of, pronoun before at, animate subject before fell, painted for opened) fires weakly, while the identity of the upcoming complement (Spain vs France, golden vs golden brown, away vs afield) leaves the peak unchanged.
